step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram shows an ingestion and machine learning pipeline for predicting flight weather impacts. Raw weather/flight data enters S3, served via Lake Formation and transformed by Glue. Processed data flows to SageMaker for ML modeling, then outputs to a second S3 bucket. Athena queries and QuickSight visuals draw from this S3 bucket, serving User and Ops personas via Athena. All visible nodes and directional arrow links are extracted precisely without speculation.
